verdicts.file: San Sisto procession near the Acropolis of Alatri.jpg
verdicts.note: Modern religious procession carrying a gilded saint statue past town houses and a crowd; the acropolis itself is not visible.
Stone steps climbing through a megalithic arched gateway in the polygonal-block fortification wall of the acropolis.
Panorama of the long polygonal-block fortification wall on its hill above the town, church and mountains behind.
Massive polygonal masonry wall with an arched gate, reached by a stone stair with balustrade - the acropolis fortification.
Stone arch gateway with a baroque niche above spanning a street, rough ancient masonry flanking it - a gate of the walled acropolis.

verdicts.file: Le mura di Porta S.Pietro - panoramio.jpg
verdicts.note: Town corner with an ancient wall of large irregular blocks on the right, Alatri road signs; the acropolis wall masonry.
Close view of a polygonal masonry wall with a small doorway closed by an iron gate, beside a cobbled lane.
Fortress wall of huge irregular blocks with a gate and stone steps with handrail, mountains visible behind - acropolis wall.
Round bastion tower with an arched gateway set in the polygonal fortification wall, cobbled path along the wall.

verdicts.file: Porta Minore vista da dentro - panoramio.jpg
verdicts.note: Interior view: long stone stairway rising through a rock-cut vaulted passage between rough walls to daylight.
Ancient-looking stepped terrace walls and foundations along a street with trees and parked cars; not recognisable as the acropolis walls.

verdicts.file: Acropoli di Alatri, pietre sparse ... una volta un tempio - panoramio.jpg
verdicts.note: Plateau of the acropolis strewn with large stone blocks, remains of a former temple, mountains beyond.
